findings.failure_path: parse_tail_slice stores `number = step.get('step_index', step_ord)` unvalidated into frozen records ['U', number] / ['C', number, ...]. A transcript whose step_index is a string (e.g. prompt/path text) persists that text in {key}.cache.json between events, bypassing the AC-1 zero-text invariant; tests only use int step_index, so the privacy assertion cannot catch it.
findings.smallest_fix: Freeze a record only when is_int(number) (otherwise set can_freeze=False), validate is_int in emit_cached_records, and add a test that uses a string step_index containing a secret.

findings.failure_path: Adding hooks/skill-extraction-gate-stop.sh to HOOK_FILE_MAP moves it out of the unmapped branch, which ran every hook suite. Editing that gate hook now selects only test_host_input.py, test_agy_bridge.py and the remaining-field-reads suite. Any dedicated or other hook suite that exercises the Stop gate silently drops out of affected-test selection.
findings.smallest_fix: Map it to the full set of suites that exercise it (or keep it unmapped), and assert that set in test_select_affected_tests.

findings.failure_path: Every cache test transcript is smaller than CACHE_BLOCK_BYTES (1 MiB), so span_block_digests' prior_blocks reuse and multi-block comparison are never executed. A wrong block offset or wrong reuse count on append could replay stale records from transcripts over 1 MiB, and the suite would stay green.
findings.smallest_fix: Add a test with a transcript over 2 MiB: append, then make a same-length edit inside a reused earlier block, and assert parity with the uncached shadow_events.

concern_results.conclusion: Checked cache privacy, block-digest invalidation, the locked sweep, the skill stat cache, tail-only shadow writes with the T4g flush, the hf_* jq convergence in all 5 hooks, and serial-runner registration. Most invariants hold as written. Found three gaps: (1) the 'zero text persisted' privacy claim can be bypassed through step_index values that are never type-checked; (2) a new HOOK_FILE_MAP entry narrows test selection for skill-extraction-gate-stop.sh; (3) no test spans more than one 1 MiB block, so the block-reuse path is never exercised.

Every hf_* value passed to eval is @sh-quoted, the variables are unset before use, and fields are bounded before the NUL split. Cache files are refused when they are linked, owned by another UID, or oversized. The remaining boundary gap is that cache records accept any JSON value as step_index, so transcript-controlled text can be written into {key}.cache.json.
